title: Demo edit deep-link boot still never fetches the edit payload (r1 W11 carry-forward)
detail: enter_demo sets vacancy_edit_id for a VacancyEdit boot but demo_entry_effects has no VacancyEdit arm, so get_for_edit never fires. Refresh on /vacancies/v-maples/edit renders an empty form (no skeleton); the r1 'edit deep-link boots with its payload' fold did not land.
recommended_fix: Add a routes.VacancyEdit(id) arm to demo_entry_effects calling demo_api.get_for_edit(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit), and set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo for that route.

title: demo_update re-implements client.gleam private helpers; the toast copy has already drifted (r1 N31 carry-forward)
evidence:
demo_update.gleam:614-617:      toasts: list.append(model.toasts, [
        model.Toast(id: toast_id, message:, level: model.ToastInfo),
      ]),
  ... global.set_timeout(5000, ...)  // no cap
--- client.gleam:7040-7058 add_toast: ---
  let updated_toasts = [new_toast, ..model.toasts]
  ... let capped_toasts = case list.length(updated_toasts) > max_toasts {
    True -> list.take(updated_toasts, max_toasts)   // max_toasts = 5
--- download_timeout duplicated: client.gleam:6844 vs demo_update.gleam:730 (both set_timeout(90_000, AppTimedOutDownloadReport)). store_of (demo_update:629) is a verbatim copy of demo_store_of (client.gleam:5874).
detail: Because add_toast/download_timeout/demo_store_of are private, demo_update duplicates them; the toast copy diverges — append vs prepend ordering and no 5-toast cap — so demo toasts render in reversed order and can stack unbounded.
recommended_fix: Hoist shared helpers (toast add with cap+ordering, download_timeout, or_seed fallback) into a shared module — e.g. demo_store.or_seed and a pub toast helper — and call them from both sides.
